page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one text column of running text with a numbered paragraph below it; a finger covers its lower part. Right page: a running head and a column of text heavily blurred, with a marginal gloss at the top; largely illegible from the scan.

main_text.p: vt pro hæro Patris volu lius Syrmie explicatio. N cedat, vel e voluntate : qu vel hæreticu rem ad totan dam,sic ait ip tate Dei, tang dicat Filium, a tur,& piè quic genitum. cap.2 6. Si qu anathema sit. voluit, sine ten tum demonstr lente genitu & Hilarius, exponit,qu tis perperam
2 Q locus ex Jam Paul Hieron toto in tri

page.notes: Left column lines are cut off at their right edge by the page curl and the finger; many line ends are illegible and are not transcribed. The right page is too blurred to read beyond the marginal gloss at the top, which is therefore omitted. Number 2 and its paragraph are only partly legible.
